title: Mizzen block lock
description: Every page block's stable identifier. mizzen build --update-blocks writes it; its presence turns block identifiers on.

pages.description: Each page's block ids, mapped to the 1-based line the block started at when the lock was written.

blocks.description: Each block id with the page and normalized-source hash it was recorded with, so an edit or move can keep it.

file.description: The page the block was on, as pages names it.

fingerprint.description: A hash of the block's normalized source.
